Name: PokePlushes
Author: DGlaky
Description:
Using the Alternative Textures mod, this mod the following textures

-15 large Pokemon textures for the Lg. Futan Bear

-﻿32 small Pokemon for the Small Junimo Plush

-﻿Alternate secret base table textures for Tables, Tea Tables, End Tables, Stools, Cushions, Statues, 'Sun' #45, 'Jade Hills', House Plants, Fancy House Plants, ﻿and Flute & Drum Blocks, 
﻿
The shiny variants of these Pokemon are included as well. These textures can be changed using the Paint Bucket item, which can be bought from Robin's shop for 500g. The Lg. Futan Bear, Small Junimo Plush,  'Sun #45', and 'Jade Hills' can now be found at the Traveling Merchant's shop.

Downloads.Description: Adds Pokemon sprites for Small Junimo Plush and Lg. Futan Bear, as well as other Secret Bases sprites using the Alternative Textures mod.
